notes: Keyboards are first-class now. On a computer, press ? anywhere for a sheet of shortcuts: Space or K to play, J and L to skip ten seconds, M to mute, < and > for speed, S, A and Q for subtitles, audio and quality, N for the next episode, a digit to jump to that tenth of the film, / to search and 1–5 for the tabs. Esc peels one layer at a time; the control buttons show their keys on hover
